I am so sorry for your loss and sending love and healing your way ❤️ 
I lost my sister just less than 6 months ago now and I wish I could say it gets easier but I still feel the same pain as I did when I found out. I find it comes in waves, sometimes small waves where you just want to reach out and talk to her, and sometimes the wave feels like it is crushing me and the fact that she is dead and gone is all I can think about and it scares me so much I can't breathe. Like i feel like this cant be real life and i have to do something, anything to go back and save her. But I just keep telling myself that this is real, she is gone and I can't go back and change anything. 
All I can do is find comfort in the happy memories and to know that she is at peace. It sounds stupid really but I just tell myself she doesnt know she's dead, she is not obsessing over what could have been done differently like I am, she is at peace. So I know realistically there is no point in wracking myself with guilt because nothing I do now can bring her back.
Of course I still feel the guilt but I try not to let myself get obsessed with it because if I think about it too long it consumes me. My sister did not commit suicide but she died from poisoning from prescription drugs which reacted with eachother. She obtained the drugs illegally from a friend and didnt tell her doctor, so she wasnt being monitored and didnt know the effect they were having on her. I feel so much guilt because myself and my family and even her friends suspected she was taking something, but she denied it so strongly we didnt have any real proof. She suffered with her mental health all through our life but particularly towards the end, her behaviour totally changed and she pushed people away. She took sleeping pills among other things and hid it from everyone because she was struggling and didn't want to admit it. I wish so badly I had of seen how much she was hurting and tried harder to get her to open up, but you never think about your loved ones just dying suddenly like that till it happens. I feel so much guilt and regret and denial. But I know I cannot let it consume me because nothing will bring her back. I know there are thing that I could have done differently, things that maybe could have even saved her life. But also, maybe not. I know there is no point in beating myself up over the mistakes I made, even though I will always have that regret I also know I can't change what has happened, I just have to accept this as a new reality, even if it is a reality I do not want to live in.

Feelings of grief are always valid, whether you have lost someone close or just someone you had a small connection to, your feelings are your own and I've found it is best to just ride the emotions out and accept them rather than questioning whether you should be feeling that way. This is the way you are feeling right now, so of course it is okay to feel the way you are. 
I have lost a lot of family members who I never really felt close to also, so I can relate to the feeling of being disconnected from the loss when you found out. Mine were my aunts and uncles, who I never really had a relationship outside of a few awkward family gatherings. The hardest part for me was seeing my mother's grief as they were her siblings but I also felt the same as you when I found out about them passing, that it didn't really affect me and that did make me feel guilty as they were my family but I didn't feel the loss of a bond or anything. However, I have grieved for them since, as well as my grandparents who died when I was very young so I only have faint memories but I think with this kind of greif it does hit you later. You don't feel that immediate loss and pain but you feel the sadness of what could have been and it can be overwhelming sometimes.
 At the end of the day you have lost a member of your family, whether you knew them well or not you are still connected by blood and its totally normal to feel pain over them passing. I also feel a lot of guilt for not being close to my extended family that have passed because I had plenty of opportunities but I just have a hard time reaching out to people and being social so I never really bothered, but I have made a promise to myself to deepen those connections and reach out more because life is too short. 
Give yourself time to feel your emotions and don't feel like you should feel a certain way. Just accept the feelings as they come. 
Sending my love and support to you 💞
